title: Taking the Backward Step
speaker: Kanho Chris Burkhart
summary: Kanho Chris Burkhart encourages listeners to take a "backward step" in meditation, turning their attention inward to let go of external distractions and conditioning, and instead experience life more mindfully and authentically. By doing so, they can see the world and themselves in a new light, revealing the unity and interdependence that lies beneath dualistic thinking. This practice allows for a direct realization of reality, unencumbered by concepts and attachments, and reveals the true nature of the self as a luminous ground of being.
